toasts.nowManagingDesc: Every action you take affects this account until you exit.

passwordReset.title: Reset password
passwordReset.description: Set a new password for {{user}}. The user keeps their account; only the password changes.
passwordReset.passwordPlaceholder: Type a password or generate one
passwordReset.hint: Minimum 6 characters. Share it with the user over a secure channel — it is not stored anywhere readable after this dialog closes.
passwordReset.savedNote: Password updated. Copy it now if you have not — closing this dialog will discard the plaintext.
passwordReset.minLengthError: Password must be at least 6 characters

crash.heading: Crash reporting → Slack
crash.webhookNotice: <mono>SLACK_ERROR_WEBHOOK_URL</mono> is not set on the server. You can flip the toggles, but no messages will be delivered until the webhook is configured — and the test button will return a 503 in this state.
crash.testDescription: Sends a synthetic message to validate the integration. Runs independently of the toggles above.
crash.testSuccess: Test message delivered to Slack. If you don't see it in the channel, double-check that the webhook URL is bound to the right one.

errors.loadConfigFailed: Failed to load crash reporting config

boundary.label: React render crashes
boundary.hint: A component throws during render (the classic full-screen error). Most production crashes fall into this bucket.

rejection.label: Unhandled async errors
rejection.hint: Rejected Promises with no .catch (window.onunhandledrejection). Useful for catching errors that would otherwise vanish silently.

window.label: Other JS errors (window.error)
window.hint: Sync errors thrown inside click/keydown handlers. Off by default because browser-extension noise can drown out real bugs.

impersonation.managingAs: Managing as {{user}}. Every action affects this user.
